name: Karei
source:
Main character wants to protect his company on the verge of bankruptcy. In order to do that he has to follow the will of Takagi who financially supports him. What Takagi wants main character to do is to train three women as obedient slaves. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-february-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公想要拯救濒临破产的公司。为此，他必须听从在经济上支持自己的高木。高木要求主人公将三名女性训练成顺从的奴隶。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-february-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
